title: Brute-Force k Nearest Neighbours
hints: Compute SQUARED distances once into a vector of (d², index) pairs. Pairs compare lexicographically, which gives you the tie-break on index for free.
k_eff = min(k, N). std::partial_sort(v.begin(), v.begin() + k_eff, v.end()) is O(N log k).
Or keep a std::priority_queue (max-heap) of size k: push, and pop when the size exceeds k. Remember to reverse at the end.
